question:
In the below series, identify what can come in place of “?”

C2, F5, I11, L17, ?, R31, U41, X47
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa560fa2ca9c79e0ecfa9c90ab75af989ef7f826c62c3c9e516cda10c9f622c.png] 

The pattern followed is,

For the numbers,

2 is a prime number and 5 is a prime number, and 3 is a prime number between them

5 is a prime number and 11 is a prime number, and 7 is a prime number between them

11 is a prime number and 17 is a prime number, and 13 is a prime number between them

17 is a prime number and 23 is a prime number, and 19 is a prime number between them

23 is a prime number and 31 is a prime number, and 29 is a prime number between them

31 is a prime number and 41 is a prime number, and 37 is a prime number between them

41 is a prime number and 47 is a prime number, and 43 is a prime number between them

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c353440b512570906d5e0165ff3c982c96bcad61df66d995bc206373988ce85b.png] 

Hence, “O23” is the correct answer.
